# `Q-5-42` — Book Scope Does Not Apply to This Format

> The whole book was requested for a format with no whole-book output.

## What this means

`book-scope: book` was requested for this render (for example with
`-M book-scope:book`), but the format does not put a book into a single file.
Only `typst`, `pdf` and `epub` have a whole-book output. `html`, `docx` and
`pptx` render each page on its own, so the request could not be honoured.

You see this warning only when the request was made for this render. A
`book-scope` set in `_quarto.yml`, in a `_metadata.yml` or in a document does
not trigger it, and neither does the default. Asking for `book-scope: chapter`
never triggers it: each page of these formats is already rendered on its own.

## How to fix

Drop `-M book-scope:book`, or render to a format that consolidates the book
(`--to typst` or `--to epub`).
